description: Inputs for flagged, derived first-cation thermal functions. Values are transcribed from the cited NIST ASD ion-energy output and Handbook Tables 5/6; no fitted coefficients are stored here.
level_cutoff_rationale: At 3000 K a level at 25000 cm-1 has Boltzmann factor exp(-hc*E/kT)=6.2e-6 before degeneracy. The cutoff captures the listed thermally relevant terms while not asserting complete bound spectra.

citation_gaps: ASD spectrum bibliography keys are retained, but the source tables do not expand every key into a full citation in this input record.
The selected ASD tables are not a completeness claim for all bound levels; only listed levels below the stated cutoff are used.
